common.engine_builds: Pre-release builds of the archived research evaluation servers.

vllm_exl3.kernels: Python-only vllm-exl3 build without vllm_exl3_c; packed operations on ExLlamaV3's kernels
vllm_exl3.serving_view: Repacked serving view of turboderp revision 55a732e0c4c3d4614bc42b68493bb930d9b02c0a

common.repeatability_scope: Synthetic repeat probes plus three NVIDIA NVFP4 runs with 670 identical evaluation-mix requests: 14.6-14.9% selection changes, maximum probability change about 0.62, shared-request accuracies 73.43%, 74.78%, 75.22%. Two runs are partial. Published-build repeatability is unmeasured.

measurement_environment.engine_builds: Pre-release builds of the archived research evaluation servers.

common.build_limitations: The three vLLM quality runs predate CUDA-graph replay of per-layer embeddings and KV-cache slot-mapping changes and were not repeated on the published build. The ExLlamaV3 quality runs used a pre-release fork build whose extension predates the released CUDA-graph kernel-argument fix and whose optimized prefill cast gated-delta-network operands to FP16; they were not repeated on the released build. Published serving builds have no end-to-end quality benchmark.

later_probe.build_relation: Same vLLM engine build as the NVIDIA NVFP4 benchmark run, with an instrumented evaluation server.

run_to_run.scope: Identical evaluation-mix request bodies across all three runs; two partial attempts and one completed run.
run_to_run.record_origin: Existing shared-request comparison from retained run records; no recomputation.

measured_settings.kernels: Python-only vllm-exl3 build without vllm_exl3_c; packed operations on ExLlamaV3's kernels
measured_settings.serving_view: Repacked serving view of turboderp revision 55a732e0c4c3d4614bc42b68493bb930d9b02c0a

kev_development.index_definition: Chance-corrected breadth-v1 index using the community Decision Index 0.2 formula: per-dataset (score - chance) / (1 - chance), with each dataset's value clipped to [0, 1], averaged within each of five areas, then 100 times the area mean.

original_fixed.unweighted_scope: Recorded evaluation-mix selection accuracy, counting any equally correct option as a hit
original_fixed.weighted_scope: Conditional API-eligible represented strata; each request is weighted by inverse subset-inclusion probability times source sampling weight.
original_fixed.vl_method_relationship: Choice and Noul use the same 100 held-out examples, reported separately.

systems.name: Jev (Kev 1.0 reference)
systems.attribution: Published by Kev (Kev 1.0); separate read of the same TEST items

paired_head_gain_over_frozen_lm.unit: record, resampled within each dataset, paired across systems

test_comparison.kev_comparison: Same breadth-v1 TEST suite; unpaired marginal intervals. FuZev trains only a head on a frozen MoE backbone (125B total, 6B active, plus 51B n-gram embeddings); Kev uses 0.8B/4B/9B backbone LoRA adapters and pointer heads or 27B full-backbone fine-tuning. FuZev is above Kev-0.8B/4B/9B v2 and below Kev-27B/Jev.

paired_difference_from_feature_only.unit: record, resampled within each dataset, paired across systems
paired_difference_from_feature_only.source_orientation: Source uncertainty.difference is control minus head; signs reversed here to state head minus feature-only.

processed_test.scope: Full held-out processed TEST split of the training-source datasets, plus external QASPER and VL-RewardBench; 15 tracks.
